summaryZh: Yaksh 实验室研究疼痛与镇痛的生物学，重点是伤害感受处理及其调控。主题包括脂筏信号复合体、慢性疼痛中的免疫机制、病毒相关疼痛和钠通道调控；页面还说明使用人源细胞、微流控培养、膜片钳与钙成像，并研究脊髓给药技术。
researchQuestions: 伤害感受处理如何受到脂筏、免疫机制和钠通道的调控？

evidence.quote: The Yaksh lab was established in 1989 to undertake research on the biology of pain and analgesia.
It has had an active presence at UCSD
focus on nociceptive processing and its regulation.
Circulating immune complexes in the chronic pain states and the dorsal root ganglion system

Work with human derived cells to create nociceptor assemblies and DRGs obtained from spine surgery and organ harvest, the use of microfluidic chambers to drive sprouting and allowing studies on soma and dendrites to undertake patch clamping and calcium imaging of DRG soma
